record.oneLiner: AI search engine over 400M+ peer-reviewed papers, exposed through a REST search API and an MCP server.
record.verdictReason: The documented REST API exposes one search endpoint authenticated by an x-api-key header, so breadth is narrow. The OAuth guide the user expected is a PDF that could not be read, and docs.consensus.app and the API subscription page returned 403, so access level is inferred from plan-scoped result caps and is unverified.
